rationale: Independent reading: held FR extract 3 FR 2359 (Oct. 4, 1938) prints '[No. 7980]' under the order 'Postponement of Effective Date of Certain Provisions of Executive Order No. 6166', which under EO 6166 sec. 22 delays the sec. 4 transfers 'until December 31, 1938, with respect to the function of disbursement now exercised by United States Marshals'; the next order on the page, [No. 7981], is the Schedule B civil-service amendment (the CLAUSES and condition TERM records wrongly attach EO 7981's text). My own status: NO by own term. The cited TERM record comes from the APP copy, but the identical words are in the official FR text, so the basis holds (defect: the basis id should point to an FR-derived record; APP is never an original). D6: no held order names EO 7980; EO 8455 (5 FR 2420) sec. 3 permanently vests the marshals' disbursement functions in Justice as of July 1, 1940, which shows intervening unheld postponements existed; whether one amended EO 7980's date rather than issuing a fresh postponement is unheld, but any such extension was closed out by EO 8455 sec. 3, so the clause is spent either way. Accept, with defect (APP-sourced basis id; mis-attributed CLAUSES record).
